threshold_rule.on: out-of-fold scores (5 folds by base listing) of legit train+calibrate rows

config_source:
# Layer 2 training config. The red-team coordinator may edit this file (and gate/features/*.py), nothing else.
kind: lightgbm            # lightgbm | logreg
features: all             # "all" or a list of feature names from gate/features/
exclude_features: ["wallet_novel_on_known_domain"]
params:                   # passed to LightGBM (n_estimators = boosting rounds); logreg reads only C
  n_estimators: 200
  num_leaves: 15
  learning_rate: 0.05
  min_data_in_leaf: 10
  lambda_l2: 1.0
threshold:
  max_fpr: 0.02           # threshold = lowest risk cut with validation fpr_l2 <= max_fpr
seed: 7

feature_sources.__init__.py: """Layer 2 features. Every module here is auto-discovered by gatepy.registry; register with @feature."""
